faq: Which carriers and tools do you connect?
Common ones such as USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL and tools like Shopify Shipping, ShipStation or Pirate Ship. Tell us what you use, or we suggest one with fair fees.
Carriers and label tools set their own prices, billed to you. Many have no monthly fee, and we show the costs first, so there are no surprises.
Can you connect a 3PL I already work with?
Yes, where the partner offers an app, an integration or an order feed that we can connect. We ask about the partner first, and tell you if the link is not possible.
Do I need to give you my carrier login?
We ask you to add us as a user or share access through the tool, where it allows. We never need your passwords or your bank details.
desc:
Fulfilment setup with carriers and labels connects your store to the tools that turn a paid order into a parcel on its way. Ecom Swift LLC links your label tool, carriers and fulfilment partner, then tests the route with a real order.

## What is fulfilment setup?

Fulfilment setup is the configuration that moves an order from the checkout to the doorstep. It covers the label tool, carrier accounts, package sizes, origin address, shipping services and, if you use one, a warehouse or fulfilment partner.

Each piece can work on its own and still fail together. A label tool may pull the wrong weight, a carrier service may not match what the customer chose, or a tracking number may never reach the shopper. Setup is the work of making these pieces agree.

## Why a loose fulfilment process slows you down

Without a connected process, you copy addresses by hand, buy labels one at a time and paste tracking numbers into orders. That is slow and it invites errors, such as the wrong service, a missing apartment number or a parcel sent to an old address. Every manual step also becomes a bottleneck when orders increase.

A connected process lets a paid order flow into a label queue, and a label flow back into the order as tracking. Staff then spend their time packing and checking, not retyping.

## How fulfilment quality shapes customer experience

Customers judge delivery as part of the product. A correct tracking link in the shipped email answers the most common order question before it is asked. Accurate delivery services keep your promise at checkout in line with what the carrier delivers, which reduces complaints and refunds.

For international orders, customs details decide whether a parcel clears quickly or sits in a warehouse. Setting them once, correctly, saves repeated corrections later.

## What a working fulfilment setup includes

- A label tool connected to your store orders.
- One or more carrier accounts linked and tested.
- Package sizes and product weights entered accurately.
- A correct origin address and return address.
- Rules that choose the carrier service by weight or destination.
- Return label settings, where you offer them.
- A branded packing slip that matches your store.
- Customs information for orders that cross borders.
- Tracking emails that reach the customer with a working link.
- A written guide for packing and shipping a new order.

## What we do

We begin by mapping how an order moves in your business today, from payment to pickup. We then connect the label tool to your store in your own account, add carrier accounts you already hold and enter your packages and weights. We set the service rules and the packing slip, and we check the origin address and the units used.

Then we run test orders. We follow each one through label creation, tracking and the customer email, and we correct anything that fails. In the Premium package, we also connect a fulfilment partner or warehouse and test the order and stock flow with them.

Your Basic, Standard and Premium choice depends on how many carriers you use, whether you ship abroad and whether a third party handles the packing. You pay carrier and tool providers directly, and our price covers the setup work. We finish with a short process guide your team can follow without us.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Weigh and measure real packed products, packaging included.
- Keep one source of truth for product weights.
- Test a label for each destination type you serve.
- Check that the shipped email shows the right carrier name and link.
- Record who handles exceptions.

**Avoid:**
- Estimating weights from memory.
- Leaving the default package size on every order.
- Mixing several label tools on one store.
- Skipping customs details for foreign parcels.
- Launching a carrier link without a test shipment.

## Who this is for

This suits a growing store that still writes labels by hand and wants to save the daily time. It suits an owner moving from self-shipping to a warehouse or fulfilment partner. It also suits a business adding a second carrier or its first export market.

## What we need from you

Send us the carriers and tools you use or plan to use, your packaging sizes and your product weights if you have them. We need a collaborator or staff user in your store, and we can work with a user the carrier or partner creates for us. We never need your passwords. We reply with a checklist and then follow the plan we agree.
